+def update_signature_args(sig: inspect.Signature, arg_types: Dict[str, type
+    ], has_self: bool, existing_annotation_strategy:
+    ExistingAnnotationStrategy=ExistingAnnotationStrategy.REPLICATE
+    ) ->inspect.Signature:
+    new_parameters = []
+    for i, (param_name, param) in enumerate(sig.parameters.items()):
+        # Skip self/cls parameter if it's a method/class method
+        if i == 0 and has_self:
+            new_parameters.append(param)

+        if param_name in arg_types:
+            new_type = arg_types[param_name]
+            # Check existing annotation strategy
+            if existing_annotation_strategy == ExistingAnnotationStrategy.IGNORE:
+                # Always override with new type
+                new_param = param.replace(annotation=new_type)
+                new_parameters.append(new_param)
+            elif existing_annotation_strategy == ExistingAnnotationStrategy.OMIT:
+                # Only set annotation if there wasn't one before
+                if param.annotation is inspect.Parameter.empty:
+                    new_param = param.replace(annotation=new_type)
+                    new_parameters.append(new_param)
+                else:
+                    new_parameters.append(param)
+            else:
+                # REPLICATE strategy - keep existing annotation if present
+                if param.annotation is inspect.Parameter.empty:
+                    new_param = param.replace(annotation=new_type)

+def shrink_traced_types(traces: Iterable[CallTrace], max_typed_dict_size: int
+    ) ->Tuple[Dict[str, type], Optional[type], Optional[type]]:
+    if not traces:
+        return {}, None, None
+    
+    # Collect all argument types and return types from traces
+    arg_types_list = []
+    return_types = []
+    yield_types = []
+    
+    for trace in traces:
+        # Shrink the argument types for this trace
+        shrunk_args = shrink_types(list(trace.arg_types.values()), max_typed_dict_size)
+        # Map back to parameter names
+        arg_types = dict(zip(trace.arg_types.keys(), shrunk_args))
+        arg_types_list.append(arg_types)
+        
+        # Collect return and yield types
+        if trace.return_type is not None:
+            return_types.append(trace.return_type)
+        if trace.yield_type is not None:
+            yield_types.append(trace.yield_type)
+    
+    # Combine all argument types by taking the union/shrink
+    combined_arg_types = {}
+    if arg_types_list:
+        # For each parameter, combine all types from different traces
+        all_param_names = set().union(*[args.keys() for args in arg_types_list])
+        for param_name in all_param_names:
+            param_types = [args.get(param_name) for args in arg_types_list if param_name in args]
+            if param_types:
+                # Shrink the types for this parameter across all traces
+                shrunk_param_types = shrink_types(param_types, max_typed_dict_size)
+                combined_arg_types[param_name] = shrunk_param_types[0] if shrunk_param_types else None
+    
+    # Shrink return types
+    shrunk_return_type = None
+    if return_types:
+        shrunk_return_type = shrink_types(return_types, max_typed_dict_size)[0] if return_types else None
+    
+    # Shrink yield types
+    shrunk_yield_type = None
+    if yield_types:
+        shrunk_yield_type = shrink_types(yield_types, max_typed_dict_size)[0] if yield_types else None
+    
+    return combined_arg_types, shrunk_return_type, shrunk_yield_type

+def render_signature(sig: inspect.Signature, max_line_len: Optional[int]=
+    None, prefix: str='') ->str:
+    # Get the parameters as a list of strings
+    param_strings = [render_parameter(p) for p in sig.parameters.values()]
+    
+    # If max_line_len is not provided, or if it's too short to fit the parameters,
+    # we'll just put everything on one line
+    if max_line_len is None or max_line_len < 10:
+        # Join parameters with commas
+        joined_params = ", ".join(param_strings)
+        return f"({joined_params})"
+    
+    # Try to fit parameters on one line
+    joined_params = ", ".join(param_strings)
+    if len(joined_params) <= max_line_len:
+        return f"({joined_params})"
+    
+    # If we can't fit on one line, split parameters across multiple lines
+    # Start with the opening parenthesis
+    result = "("
+    indent = " " * (len(prefix) + 1)  # One space after the opening paren
+    
+    # Add each parameter on a separate line
+    for i, param_str in enumerate(param_strings):
+        if i == 0:
+            # First parameter
+            result += param_str
+        else:
+            # Subsequent parameters
+            result += f"\n{indent}{param_str}"
+    
+    # Close with a newline and closing parenthesis
+    result += "\n)"
